entities.name: Phenolic chromene substrate
observations: Decoded SELFIES to canonical SMILES CC1(C)C=C(c2ccc3ccccc3c2)c2ccc(O)cc2O1; formula C21H18O2; contains one phenolic OH.

entities.name: 2-chloroethyl diethylamine
observations: Decoded SELFIES to CCN(CC)CCCl; formula C6H14ClN; a 2-chloroethyl tertiary amine capable of substitution or amine quaternization.

entities.name: Tertiary aminoether chromane
observations: Decoded SELFIES to CN(C)CCOc1ccc2c(c1)OC(C)(C)CC2c1ccc(C(F)(F)F)cc1; formula C22H26F3NO2; contains a tertiary amine but no obvious leaving group.

entities.name: Plausible phenol O-alkylation
observations: Tentative route: the phenolic substrate could displace chloride from 2-chloro-N,N-diethylethanamine to form an aryl 2-(diethylamino)ethyl ether; exact reaction evidence was not obtained.
